svg.title: ReaLVR: grounding a latent trajectory in visual evidence
svg.desc: Conceptual training illustration. Relevant and mismatched visual prototypes enter a weighted visual margin. Correct and wrong answer readouts create detached latent weights. Visual margin gradients flow through one differentiable current-model autoregressive trajectory. GRPO rewards and inference are unchanged.
svg.text: FROM VISUAL EVIDENCE TO GROUNDED LATENT REASONING
Gradients stay connected through the recurrence
Weights are read out, then detached
